tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The page behind notes and the middle views (Tasks, Meetings, Start).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Text on background, card, sidebar and muted.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised things: dialogs, menus, toasts, epic boxes, start-page widgets, inputs' popups.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Hover on rows and ghost buttons; the ground of small fact pills (Note, Epic, Meeting).

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: facts, dates, hints, placeholders, section labels. On background, card and sidebar.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: panel edges, cards, dividers, table cells.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and outline buttons.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one main action of a view or dialog, today in the calendar, a checked box, links, the pinned star.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The selected item (current row, open rail icon, pressed filter), tag chips, the Doing status.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete buttons in a confirm dialog, error toasts' border, error text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done (a finished epic's bar), success toasts' border, Can use tools.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: The Waiting status (at 25% as a ground), notes about a conflict on disk, No tools. As text (the No tools chip) it is below 4.5:1 on card in the light theme; use it for grounds and borders, and put foreground text on it.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The focus ring (2px) on every control.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The side panels, the icon rails, the header and the status bar.

families.sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The title in a ViewHeader (Tasks, a meeting, Welcome back) and dialog titles.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: The one big name inside a widget or card (Continue).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Rows, buttons, inputs, menus, dialog text. The app's base size.

styles.name: row-strong
styles.usage: A task title or an epic name in a list.

styles.name: tree
styles.usage: File tree, Landing and Recent rows in the side panel.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Facts, hints, small buttons (size sm), chips.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: The small UPPERCASE heading over a group, in muted-foreground (the section-label utility).

styles.name: editor
styles.usage: Note text in the editor (the person can change the size in Settings).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, inline code, keyboard keys.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and a tight label; the gap in chip groups.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: The gap inside buttons (icon to text); padding of menu items.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The gap between buttons in a header and between rows' parts.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel side padding (PanelHeader), gap inside dialogs, between widgets' parts.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Dialog and widget padding; the gap between start-page widgets.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: The side gutter of every middle view (ViewHeader and its page).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page (start page).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu items, toast action buttons, keyboard keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, menus, rows, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, epic boxes, meeting note boxes, task rows' hover.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Start-page widgets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips (tags, status, filters, counts) and the date dots.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs (over a 50% black overlay).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons (default), inputs and selects.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons in headers and panels; icon buttons.

tokens.name: view-header-height
tokens.usage: The ViewHeader of every middle view.

tokens.name: panel-header-height
tokens.usage: The PanelHeader of every side panel.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The icon rails at the left and right edge.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, menus and rails (lucide-react).
